about_the_game:
Realm Architect is a new Virtual Tabletop solution with a modern and intuitive user interface. It completely changes the way you create and play campaigns, making it easier than ever before to set up entire worlds, or Realms as we prefer to call them, and removing the time-consuming stress of preparing everything down to the most minor of details.

Realm Architect is MORE than just another Virtual TableTop:
  • It uses a VTT base as the blueprint, with all your data available in a digital platform
  • but layers the accessibility of (single-player) RPG videogames on top,
  • and adds a host of easy-to-learn worldbuilding tools GMs have been craving for.

To empower you to create the best stories ever told, that’s what Realm Architect is all about! Build quickly entire realms for your players to adventure through.



Realm Architect requires zero coding. Every essential element is right there for you to drag & drop onto your map. The possibilities are endless, whether you want to upload your own character sheets and monster manuals or use existing ones, it's as easy as the click of a button.



Want to use your own maps? Just upload them and scale the grid as you see fit!
As life goes on, game masters often find themselves with a lack of time to keep investing in their running campaigns. Fatigue sets in, and you risk losing your motivation to keep planning ahead and gathering all the resources or inspiration needed for the next session.



We've tried a lot of VTT solutions ourselves, and understand the struggles all too well. Other tools require too much time to set up or require the GM to almost have an engineer's degree worth of technical know-how. It's gotten too complicated and with all the feature creep, it's become impossible to find the most basic of things you're looking for.

After a long day’s work and coming home, the last thing you want to do is learn how to use one of the many VTTs out there, before even being able to start building your campaign!

name: Realm Architect

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit (x64) Windows 8x or 10x
  • Processor: 1.6 GHz or higher processor (SSE2 instruction set support)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with DX10 (Shader Model 4.0) capabilities and a minimum of 2 GB of graphics memory
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: A sound card is required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10x (x64)
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz or higher processor (SSE2 instruction set support)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with DX10 (Shader Model 4.0) capabilities and a minimum of 3 GB of graphics memory
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: A sound card is required

short_description: An easy to use, immersive worldbuilding VTT that saves you time. Build worlds and play TTRPG's at your pace!
